C0449.title: ASEAN Nations Crack Down on Fake Inventory in Cross-Border E-Commerce
C0449.summary: In May 2026, ASEAN countries jointly launched the "Cross-Border Digital Trade Purification Operation," targeting the novel crime of using "fake inventory" for money laundering and linked cross-border online gambling.
